arrow_traceability.reason: All six static stems, routes and downward heads are individually traceable, with zero crossings, shared runs or fake junctions, unambiguous labels, and six near-minimal monotone routes. Nevertheless F1 violates the explicit rule that a dot starting away from its origin leaves arrow direction unproven: all six frame-0 dots start one cell past the first drawn stem. This known failure is not waived by otherwise readable arrows.

Observed 0 bridges/0 touching bends agrees with check. Source leaves lateral branch order free; no group or relation was reordered across semantic tiers to reduce crossings.

findings.description: Known defect affecting arrow_traceability and animation: all six frame-0 dots occupy the second drawn cell, one cell beyond the first visible stem. First-cell -> dot coordinates are (37,11)->(37,12), (39,19)->(39,20), (37,19)->(37,20), (24,27)->(24,28), (24,35)->(24,36), (50,27)->(50,28). The rubric requires the first drawn cell in both timing modes; excluding the visible port stem is not permitted. Static arrows remain readable, but the explicit origin gate fails every edge. check.txt origins:6/6 and validator PASS do not override captured pixels.

Known localized legibility defect: e1 alternates only (37,12)/(37,13), and e4 only (24,28)/(24,29), with 200ms holds and 400ms cycles. Each dot returns upward after every one-cell downward move, so it reads as a two-cell bobble, not slow directed traffic. Stationary arrowheads preserve semantic direction, but do not make this animation legible. Five cycles per short route are captured. This fails animation even though the framewise dot count is exactly one.

Evidence gap, not a constant-mode arrival defect: the only pinned direct window is frames 0-20, 0-2000ms. These four long-route dots remain mid-route and never wrap to their starts, so a full cycle is not captured. The pane copy supplies no later frames and loses the start of frame 0. Full-cycle motion proof is required even though unequal arrival times and no dot touching an arrowhead are legal in this constant-mode source. workflow_evidence is blocked; animation remains fail for independently observed F1/F2.

Evidence gap: all three draft specs and raw check text files are preserved, but the supplied bundle has no exact executed per-attempt command/cwd or raw process exit-status record, no preserved evidence-harness invocation, and no raw close/probe command/status output. Final check exit=0 and timestamps and cleanup=confirmed_closed are recorded in manifest.json and accepted as records, but they cannot supply the missing rejected-draft/probe command/status logs. No missing exit status or successful probe is invented. The reproduced direct-dump and validator command strings do not repair the absent workflow records.
